# Design Decisions

## DD-001: Generic JSON-RPC only

The core is a JSON-RPC engine. Domain logic belongs above it.

## DD-002: `method` is opaque

`RpcClient.call(method, params)` accepts a string. The core does not parse namespaces.

## DD-003: Hooks are ordered callbacks

The first version uses simple ordered hooks rather than a full middleware system.

## DD-004: Metrics are separate from hooks

Metrics observe. Hooks may transform. Keeping them separate prevents hidden mutation in telemetry code.

## DD-005: Cache is explicit and disabled by default

The core cannot know which methods are safe to cache.

## DD-006: Structured errors

Every public error has a stable category so callers can retry, log or transform safely.

## DD-007: ESM/CJS compatibility

The package builds both ESM and CJS outputs while source code remains ESM TypeScript.
